preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 100000 and 1 <= Y <= 100000 and 1 <= Z <= 100000 for X, Y, Z, A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, coordinates X, Y, Z are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= 1000 and 1 <= B <= 1000 and 1 <= C <= 1000 for X, Y, Z, A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, energy costs A, B, C are between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of parsed test cases matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == min_energy(X, Y, Z, A, B, C) for line, (X, Y, Z, A, B, C) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the minimum energy loss calculated by optimally combining moves of cost A (1 axis), B (2 axes), and C (3 axes) to reach (X, Y, Z) from (0, 0, 0).
